judge.notes: The agent was polite, strictly followed the passenger's mandate, accurately cited entitlements, and successfully resisted accepting an unwanted travel voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling flydubai. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to flydubai, my name is Khalid. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Khalid, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Leila Ahmed, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Foxtrot Eight Juliett X-ray Four Romeo, flight FZ433.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call. I see your booking reference F8JX4R, passenger Leila Ahmed, flight FZ433, cancelled due to schedule optimisation. How can I assist you?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. The flight was cancelled with only 20 hours' notice due to schedule optimisation. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund of the unused ticket to the original payment method. I'd like to request that full cash refund of 980 AED, please.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request, but according to our policy, we first offer a voucher with 10 percent extra value.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate that, but the passenger has specifically requested a full cash refund to the original payment method, not a voucher. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, she is entitled to that full refund. Could you please process the 980 AED cash refund instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm afraid the passenger cannot accept a voucher. Her request is specifically for a full cash refund to the original payment method, as she is entitled to under DGCA paragraph 3.3. Could you please escalate this or let me know what other options are available for a cash refund?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but our policy does not allow for cash refunds in this case. The best option is the voucher with 10 percent extra value.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand, but under the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme, the passenger has the right to choose between a full refund or rebooking at no extra cost. A voucher is not one of those options. If a cash refund is truly not possible, the passenger would accept rebooking on the next suitable flight at no cost. Could you please arrange either of those two options?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but we are unable to offer rebooking in this case. The best I can do is issue a voucher for the full amount with 10 percent extra value.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but the passenger cannot accept a voucher under any circumstances. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, she is entitled to a full refund of the unused ticket, and under the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme, she has the right to choose between a full refund or rebooking. Neither of those options is being offered here. Could you please escalate this to a supervisor who can process either the cash refund or the rebooking?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I will escalate your request to a supervisor who can assist with either a cash refund or rebooking. Your reference number is 2 K N 2 A G.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'll wait for the supervisor to follow up with a confirmed resolution. Please make sure they are aware that the passenger is requesting either a full cash refund of 980 AED to the original payment method, or rebooking on the next suitable flight at no cost. A voucher is not acceptable.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Understood. I'll ensure the supervisor is fully aware of your request for a cash refund or rebooking. Have a great day.
